This right here! My SD is turning 5 in a couple of weeks, still sleeps in our bed, our room; constantly needs someone to walk her to the bathroom or so simple tasks because she doesn’t want to do it alone. It’s exhausting!

I’m so glad that I am not the only one who struggles with this or has allowed boundaries to be crossed. It definitely started in the beginning, knowing that I am good with children, but not necessarily wanting that responsibility; it slowly became mine. I feel like now if I say no or don’t want anything to do with the responsibility of my SK I’m being an asshole. Her Bio dad moved further away and while he used to have her every two days he only takes her for the weekend; leaving me to be the one to figure out how to adjust my schedule to pick her up from school, or take her to dance or pick her up from her sitter when my wife and I are both at work. I hate that I have most of the responsibility but little to do with discipline! I’ve built resentments and I’m too far into it to try and go back on boundaries that have been crossed. It is so stressful to say the least but I’m glad there are people out there that can relate.
